## Conclusions
- **Fine-tuned S0 (exp 015) is valid and as fast as before: 6.82 + 3.23 = 10.05 ms** on the Galaxy S22 (exp 004:
  10.06 ms). Training un-reparameterized and reparameterizing at export works on device.
- **Device = PyTorch:** device sample frac R@10 90.71 equals local FP32; minimum cosine 0.9998 / 1.0000.
- **Two submission entries, both verified on the S22:**

  | Entry | Model | S22 ms | RefCOCOg-LPCVC | LPCVC sample |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | Official baseline | CLIP ViT-B/16 | 15.83 | 63.19 | 87.35 |
  | Accuracy | MobileCLIP2-B fine-tuned (010) | 17.68 | 87.34 | 91.37 |
  | Speed | MobileCLIP2-S0 fine-tuned (015) | 10.05 | 82.24 | 90.71 |

- `pareto.png` here combines exps 004, 006, 011 and 016: the fine-tuned models (red diamonds) form the new
  Pareto front, 11–16 points above every pretrained model at equal latency.
